    Class
    Description
    RowRefillResult
    Value object returned by Board.refillTopRow(PlayerCount, Era) that describes what happened during the row refill: whether an era transition was triggered, which era was entered, and whether the tribe deck is now exhausted.
    RowSlot
    A single slot in a visible row.
    VisibleRowState
    Holds the ordered list of RowSlots that make up a visible row (top or bottom).
